entries.text: Never send plain text. Hold the middle ford with all foot; elephants guard the west ford. Send a decoy before every attack.
Speed wins. Send plain orders by road. Horse hunts enemy riders on the north bank. Take the east ford early and hold it.
Make rivals read what you want: send decoys that name the west ford, then attack the east ford. Offer a truce to rhino early.
Two riders by two roads for every order. Archers shoot riders near the ferry. Push across the middle ford once two others are fighting.
Strike first. Send horse across the west ford at once and raid the orchid camp for its standard. Orders plain, speed over secrecy.
Make peace with everyone early by letter, then take the middle ford while they fight each other. Cipher everything.
Trust nothing old. Re-send every order twice by different roads. Hold the east ford with elephants and foot; archers on the north bank shoot every rider.
Decoys every watch naming the west ford. Real orders ciphered by the hill road. Mass everything on the east ford late.
Plain fast orders. Take the east ford with everything in the first five watches and hold it to the end.
Defend. Hold the west and middle fords with foot and elephants and never leave them. Horse hunts riders between them.
Offer rhino a truce, then betray it at the last watch. Use smoke to advance all at once near the end.
Horse rides the north bank catching rivals riders; read every captured letter and send foot wherever the enemy says it is going.
